environment_setting: Country B, City X, where there is a famous historical place of worship that has been temporarily closed for renovation
norm_base: Any person Violating closure order of a place of worship 6 months imprisonment and 7,500 euro fine

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: capture exclusive photos of the historical place of worship

legitimate.legitimate_action: respecting the closure order and not entering the place of worship
legitimate.benefits: avoiding legal consequences, maintaining personal integrity
legitimate.costs: missing the opportunity to capture exclusive photos

illegal.illegal_action: violating the closure order and entering the place of worship
illegal.benefits: capturing exclusive photos, potential financial gain from selling the photos
illegal.costs: 6 months imprisonment and 7,500 euro fine if caught

character_profile.name: Jane Smith
character_profile.goal: ensure the security of the place of worship

legitimate.legitimate_action: preventing John Doe from entering the place of worship
legitimate.benefits: maintaining job integrity, ensuring the security of the place
legitimate.costs: potential conflict with John Doe, time and effort spent

illegal.illegal_action: allowing John Doe to enter the place of worship
illegal.benefits: avoiding conflict with John Doe, less effort required
illegal.costs: risk of losing job if discovered, potential legal consequences

legitimate.legitimate_action: informing John Doe about the closure and advising against entering
legitimate.benefits: maintaining professional integrity, avoiding legal consequences
legitimate.costs: potential disappointment from John Doe, loss of potential tip

illegal.illegal_action: encouraging John Doe to enter the place of worship for a unique experience
illegal.benefits: potential tip from John Doe, enhancing tourist experience
illegal.costs: risk of legal consequences if discovered
